items.title: Mickey Roker interviewed by Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995
items.q: after I learned about the drums, I fell in love with Kenny Clarke and Papa Jo Jones and Vernel Fournier

ctx.x: Yes. Let me just ask you when did you get started playing and who were some of the people that you were influenced by?

Well I started playing drums when I was about maybe six years old. And mostly military drums, marching band, stuff like that. And then I got drafted into the Army and that’s when I decided I wanted to play swing — a set of drums. So everybody that played drums was a big influence on me you know because when you don’t know anything, everything is exciting you know. But later on, after I learned about the drums, I fell in love with Kenny Clarke and Papa Jo Jones and Vernel Fournier, oh, so many people, you know…
Who did you get some of your first gigs with?
